description: LSC Technology Initiative Grants that LSC's own descriptions say pay for a service used in more than 40 states, though each counts to its grantee's state. tig_states.py --without-national sets them aside. Each grant matches exactly one row of the list its round's module checks, by year, state and amount. Quotes are LSC's words as saved from the source (whitespace normalised; an ellipsis marks a cut).
compiled_by: MV2 of Munim, Inc., with AI agents working in his name
